clips.text: AgentWorkShop — an industrial multi-agent platform, recorded live on a running production line.
Every line, every signal, one control room. Hardware in, decisions out — and nothing leaves the governed path.
Live telemetry, six field protocols — every sample stamped with its batch, recipe and line.
The new E D A pipeline. Pull live data — or bring your own table.
Shape it with your own code: filters, aggregates, derived columns — executed right in your browser.
Choose a chart, tune the fields, save the whole recipe as a template. New data, one click, re-plotted.
Every setpoint is a governed decision: four interlock layers, human approval, and a signed audit trail.
Agents propose. The platform verifies. You decide.
First bindings are approval-gated, every write is rate-limited and journaled — by design, not by policy.
Ontology makes the plant machine-readable — entities, relations and rules, each bound to a real node.
Models learn from the line, then serve optimization through a guarded solver. Nothing is trusted until it passes.
And a solver cross-checks every recommendation against the physics it learned from.
Different agents, different tools, different permissions — scoped down to the node.
A diagnostics bridge streams real analyses from I D D: deep diagnosis, stability reports, quick screens — searchable and reusable.
Protocols, analyses, twins — all plugins. Load one, and its tools appear for the right agents only.
In one live run, a governed loop moved hold pressure from sixty-five to seventy bar, verified on the device, then sealed as recipe version three.
Every chart is a saved, reusable view — owned, versioned, and shareable with the team.
AgentWorkShop. Open source, plugin-ready, built for the shop floor.

cues.en: AgentWorkShop — an industrial multi-agent platform, recorded live on a running production line.
cues.zh: AgentWorkShop——工业多智能体平台，在真实运行的产线上实录。

cues.en: Every line, every signal, one control room. Hardware in, decisions out — and nothing leaves the governed path.
cues.zh: 所有产线、所有信号汇入同一个控制室。硬件数据流入，决策流出——每一步都不离开受治理的路径。

cues.en: Live telemetry, six field protocols — every sample stamped with its batch, recipe and line.
cues.zh: 现场遥测，六种现场协议——每个样本都带批次、配方与产线归属。

cues.en: The new E D A pipeline. Pull live data — or bring your own table.
cues.zh: 全新的 EDA 分析管道。实时拉取产线数据——或直接导入你自己的数据表。

cues.en: Shape it with your own code: filters, aggregates, derived columns — executed right in your browser.
cues.zh: 用你自己的代码塑形数据：过滤、聚合、派生列——全部在你的浏览器本地执行。

cues.en: Choose a chart, tune the fields, save the whole recipe as a template. New data, one click, re-plotted.
cues.zh: 选择图型、调整字段，把整套配置保存为模板。换一份数据，一键复绘。

cues.en: Every setpoint is a governed decision: four interlock layers, human approval, and a signed audit trail.
cues.zh: 每个设定值都是一次受治理的决策：四层联锁限界、人工审批、带签名的审计痕迹。

cues.en: Agents propose. The platform verifies. You decide.
cues.zh: Agent 提议，平台核验，由你决定。

cues.en: First bindings are approval-gated, every write is rate-limited and journaled — by design, not by policy.
cues.zh: 首次绑定强制审批，每次写入限频并留痕——这是代码设计，不是纸面制度。

cues.en: Ontology makes the plant machine-readable — entities, relations and rules, each bound to a real node.
cues.zh: 本体让工厂可被机器理解——实体、关系与规则，每一条都绑定真实节点。

cues.en: Models learn from the line, then serve optimization through a guarded solver. Nothing is trusted until it passes.
cues.zh: 模型从产线学习，经守卫求解器服务优化。没过门禁的模型，一步也不放行。

cues.en: And a solver cross-checks every recommendation against the physics it learned from.
cues.zh: 求解器再用学到的物理关系，对每个推荐做交叉核验。

cues.en: Different agents, different tools, different permissions — scoped down to the node.
cues.zh: 不同 Agent、不同工具、不同权限——作用域收窄到节点级。

cues.en: A diagnostics bridge streams real analyses from I D D: deep diagnosis, stability reports, quick screens — searchable and reusable.
cues.zh: 诊断桥接通 IDD：深度诊断、稳定报告、快速筛查——可检索、可复用。

cues.en: Protocols, analyses, twins — all plugins. Load one, and its tools appear for the right agents only.
cues.zh: 协议、分析、孪生都是插件：装载即出现，且只对授权的 Agent 可见。

cues.en: In one live run, a governed loop moved hold pressure from sixty-five to seventy bar, verified on the device, then sealed as recipe version three.
cues.zh: 一次实机闭环把保压从 65 bar 调到 70 bar，设备证实后固化为配方第三版。
数据、决策、行动——全程留证。

cues.en: Every chart is a saved, reusable view — owned, versioned, and shareable with the team.
cues.zh: 每张图表都是可复用的保存视图——有归属、有版本,可共享给团队。

cues.en: AgentWorkShop. Open source, plugin-ready, built for the shop floor.
cues.zh: AgentWorkShop。开源、可插件化、为车间而生。
